measures.name: Story | Active Projects
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[State_Value] = "Active" ) ) + 0
measures.description: Project plans whose state is "Active" (a blank state does not count).

measures.name: Story | On Track %
measures.expression:
VAR _tot = CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[State_Value] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[OverallHealth_Value] ) ) )
VAR _ok = CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[State_Value] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[OverallHealth_Value] = "(1) On Track" ) )
RETURN IF ( _tot > 0, DIVIDE ( COALESCE ( _ok, 0 ), _tot ) )
measures.description: Share of active projects whose overall health is (1) On Track.

measures.name: Story | Refreshed
measures.expression:
VAR _t = MAX ( RefreshTime[Last Refreshed (Belgium Time)] )
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _t ), "POWERED BY ONEPLAN", "POWERED BY ONEPLAN  ·  REFRESHED " & UPPER ( FORMAT ( _t, "dd mmm yyyy hh:nn" ) ) & " CET" )

measures.name: Story | Finance EAC
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactCost[Cost] ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactCost[CostType] = "EAC" ), REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: Estimate at completion (FactCost EAC) of project plans, lifetime: ignores the date filter.

measures.name: Story | Budget At Completion
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Finance | Budget Cost], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: Total budget of project plans over the plan lifetime (FactCost Budget), ignores the date filter.

measures.name: Story | Budget In Period
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Finance | Budget Cost], KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: Budget of project plans phased by date (respects the date filter).

measures.name: Story | Actual Cost
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Finance | Actual Cost], KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: Actual cost of project plans phased by date (respects the date filter).

measures.name: Story | Forecast Cost
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Finance | Forecast Cost], KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: Forecast cost of project plans phased by date (respects the date filter).

measures.name: Story | EAC Variance
measures.expression:
VAR _e = [Story | Finance EAC]
VAR _b = [Story | Budget At Completion]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _e ) && ISBLANK ( _b ), BLANK (), COALESCE ( _e, 0 ) - COALESCE ( _b, 0 ) )
measures.description: EAC minus budget at completion. Positive = expected overrun.

measures.name: Story | EAC Variance %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | EAC Variance], [Story | Budget At Completion] )

measures.name: Story | EAC In Period
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactCost[Cost] ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactCost[CostType] = "EAC" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: EAC of project plans phased by date (respects the date filter) — for trend charts only.

measures.name: Story | Budget To Date
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Story | Budget In Period], KEEPFILTERS ( DimDate[Date] <= TODAY () ) )
measures.description: Budget of project plans phased up to today (within the selected period).

measures.name: Story | To-Date Variance
measures.expression:
VAR _a = [Story | Actual Cost]
VAR _b = [Story | Budget To Date]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _a ) && ISBLANK ( _b ), BLANK (), COALESCE ( _a, 0 ) - COALESCE ( _b, 0 ) )
measures.description: Actual cost minus budget to date. Positive = spending ahead of plan.

measures.name: Story | To-Date Variance %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | To-Date Variance], [Story | Budget To Date] )

measures.name: Story | Burn %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Story | Actual Cost], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ) ), [Story | Budget At Completion] )
measures.description: Lifetime actual cost as a share of budget at completion.

measures.name: Story | Projects Over Budget
measures.expression:
COUNTROWS (
    FILTER (
        VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ),
        VAR _b = [Story | Budget At Completion]
        RETURN NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) && _b > 0 && [Story | Finance EAC] > _b
    )
) + 0
measures.description: Projects with a budget whose EAC exceeds it.

measures.name: Story | Forecast Variance
measures.expression: [Story | Forecast Cost] - [Story | Budget In Period]
measures.description: Forecast cost minus budget cost of project plans in the selected period (FactCost).

measures.name: Story | Forecast Variance %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Forecast Variance], [Story | Budget In Period] )

measures.name: Story | Variance Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _p = [Story | EAC Variance %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ), BLANK (), IF ( _p > 0.05, "#C0392B", IF ( _p > 0, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )
measures.description: Red > 5% over budget at completion, amber slightly over, teal within budget.

measures.name: Story | To-Date Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _p = [Story | To-Date Variance %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ), BLANK (), IF ( _p > 0.05, "#C0392B", IF ( _p > 0, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Burn Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _p = [Story | Burn %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ), BLANK (), IF ( _p > 1, "#C0392B", IF ( _p > 0.9, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Cum Budget
measures.expression:
VAR _d = MAX ( DimDate[Date] )
VAR _first = CALCULATE ( MIN ( FactCost[Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
VAR _last = CALCULATE ( MAX ( FactCost[Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
VAR _out = ISBLANK ( _first ) || MIN ( DimDate[Date] ) > _last || _d < _first
RETURN IF ( NOT _out, CALCULATE ( [Story | Budget In Period], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), DimDate[Date] <= _d ) )
measures.description: Lifetime cumulative budget up to the end of the period on the axis.

measures.name: Story | Cum Actual
measures.expression:
VAR _d = MAX ( DimDate[Date] )
VAR _first = CALCULATE ( MIN ( FactCost[Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
VAR _last = CALCULATE ( MAX ( FactCost[Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
VAR _out = ISBLANK ( _first ) || MIN ( DimDate[Date] ) > _last || _d < _first
VAR _cut = MIN ( _d, TODAY () )
RETURN IF ( NOT _out && MIN ( DimDate[Date] ) <= TODAY (),
    CALCULATE ( [Story | Actual Cost], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), DimDate[Date] <= _cut ) )
measures.description: Lifetime cumulative actual cost; blank after today.

measures.name: Story | Cum EAC
measures.expression:
VAR _d = MAX ( DimDate[Date] )
VAR _first = CALCULATE ( MIN ( FactCost[Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
VAR _last = CALCULATE ( MAX ( FactCost[Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
VAR _out = ISBLANK ( _first ) || MIN ( DimDate[Date] ) > _last || _d < _first
RETURN IF ( NOT _out,
    CALCULATE ( [Story | EAC In Period], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), DimDate[Date] <= _d ) )
measures.description: Lifetime cumulative phased EAC; ends at the EAC.

measures.name: Story | Finance Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _bac = [Story | Budget At Completion]
VAR _eac = [Story | Finance EAC]
VAR _v = [Story | EAC Variance]
VAR _absv = ABS ( _v )
VAR _btd = [Story | Budget To Date]
VAR _a = [Story | Actual Cost]
VAR _n = [Story | Projects Over Budget]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER (
            ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@n", CALCULATE ( MAX ( DimProject[Name] ) ),
                "@b", [Story | Budget At Completion], "@v", [Story | EAC Variance] ),
            NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) && [@b] > 0 && [@v] > 0 ),
        [@v], DESC, DimProject[Id], ASC )
VAR _tn = MAXX ( _top, [@n] )
VAR _tv = MAXX ( _top, [@v] )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( _bac ) && ISBLANK ( _eac ),
        "No financial plan data in the current selection.",
        "At completion: budget " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _bac ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _bac ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _bac / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _bac ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _bac / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _bac, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & ", EAC " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _eac ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _eac ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _eac / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _eac ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _eac / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _eac, "#,0" ) ) ) )
            & IF ( COALESCE ( _v, 0 ) >= 0, "  →  +", "  →  −" ) & IF ( ISBLANK ( _absv ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _absv ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _absv / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _absv ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _absv / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _absv, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " ("
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _v, _bac ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _v, _bac ), "+0.0%;-0.0%" ) ) & "). To date: actuals " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _a ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _a ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _a / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _a ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _a / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _a, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " against "
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _btd ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _btd ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _btd / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _btd ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _btd / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _btd, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " budgeted (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _a, _btd ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _a, _btd ), "0%" ) ) & "). "
            & IF ( _n > 0,
                FORMAT ( _n, "0" ) & " project(s) have an EAC above budget; the largest overrun is " & _tn & " (+" & IF ( ISBLANK ( _tv ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _tv ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _tv / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _tv ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _tv / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _tv, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & ").",
                "No project has an EAC above its budget." )
    )

measures.name: Story | Proposed Projects
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[State_Value] = "Proposed" ) ) + 0

measures.name: Story | Aligned Budget %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    CALCULATE ( SUM ( DimProject[Budget] ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[StrategicAlignment_Value] IN { "Strong", "Extreme" } ) ),
    SUM ( DimProject[Budget] )
)
measures.description: Share of plan-field budget in projects rated Strong or Extreme strategic alignment.

measures.name: Story | Plan Budget
measures.expression: SUM ( DimProject[Budget] )
measures.description: Budget field on the project plan (DimProject), lifetime, not time-phased.

measures.name: Story | Plan Forecast
measures.expression: SUM ( DimProject[Forecast] )
measures.description: Forecast field on the project plan (DimProject), lifetime, not time-phased.

measures.name: Story | Plan Variance %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Plan Forecast] - [Story | Plan Budget], [Story | Plan Budget] )

measures.name: Story | Plan Variance Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _p = [Story | Plan Variance %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ), BLANK (), IF ( _p > 0.05, "#C0392B", IF ( _p > 0, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Priority Score
measures.expression: AVERAGE ( DimProject[PrioritizationScore] )
measures.description: Prioritisation score from the OnePlan plan (DimProject[PrioritizationScore]).

measures.name: Story | Health Colour
measures.expression:
SWITCH ( SELECTEDVALUE ( DimProject[OverallHealth_Value] ),
    "(1) On Track", "#1E6D6E",
    "(2) At Risk", "#D9A832",
    "(3) Off Track", "#C0392B",
    "#666666" )

measures.name: Story | Step Index
measures.expression: MIN ( DimProject[ProcessStepIndex] )
measures.description: Lifecycle step order, used to sort lifecycle charts.

measures.name: Story | Portfolio Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _n = [Story | Active Projects]
VAR _p =
    COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( DimProject[Portfolio Name] ),
        NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Portfolio Name] ) && DimProject[Portfolio Name] <> "(No portfolio)" ) )
VAR _b = [Story | Plan Budget]
VAR _al = [Story | Aligned Budget %]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Portfolio Name] ), "@b", CALCULATE ( SUM ( DimProject[Budget] ) ) ),
            NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Portfolio Name] ) && [@b] > 0 ),
        [@b], DESC, DimProject[Portfolio Name], ASC )
VAR _tn = MAXX ( _top, DimProject[Portfolio Name] )
VAR _tb = MAXX ( _top, [@b] )
VAR _prop = [Story | Proposed Projects]
VAR _ot = [Story | On Track %]
RETURN
    FORMAT ( _n, "0" ) & " active projects across " & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _p, 0 ), "0" ) & " portfolios; the plans carry "
        & IF ( ISBLANK ( _b ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _b ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _b / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _b ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _b / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _b, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " of plan-field budget. " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _al ), "–", FORMAT ( _al, "0%" ) ) & " of it sits in Strong/Extreme-aligned work; the largest share goes to "
        & _tn & " (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _tb, _b ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _tb, _b ), "0%" ) ) & "). " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _ot ), "–", FORMAT ( _ot, "0%" ) ) & " of active projects report On Track overall and "
        & FORMAT ( _prop, "0" ) & " proposal(s) wait in the pipeline."

measures.name: Story | Scheduled Hours
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Capacity | Total Hours Scheduled], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimProject ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) )
measures.description: Scheduled resource-plan hours on project plans, organisation-wide (project slicers ignored).

measures.name: Story | Committed Hours
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Capacity | Committed], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimProject ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) )
measures.description: Committed resource-plan hours on project plans, organisation-wide. A separate figure, not a subset of scheduled.

measures.name: Story | Scheduled FTE
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Project | Scheduled FTE], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimProject ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) )
measures.description: Scheduled FTE on project plans, organisation-wide.

measures.name: Story | Project Scheduled Hours
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Capacity | Total Hours Scheduled], KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: Scheduled resource-plan hours of project plans; follows project filters (demand by project).

measures.name: Story | Project Committed Hours
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Capacity | Total Hours Committed], KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: Committed resource-plan hours of project plans; follows project filters.

measures.name: Story | Utilisation %
measures.expression:
VAR _c = [Capacity | Resource Capacity]
RETURN IF ( _c > 0, DIVIDE ( COALESCE ( [Story | Scheduled Hours], 0 ), _c ) )
measures.description: Scheduled hours on project plans ÷ capacity, organisation-wide. Blank when there is no capacity.

measures.name: Story | Over-allocated People
measures.expression:
VAR _t =
    CALCULATETABLE (
        ADDCOLUMNS ( SUMMARIZE ( FactCapacity, DimResource[ResourceKey], DimDate[MonthStart] ), "@u", [Story | Utilisation %] ),
        KEEPFILTERS ( DimResource[Inactive] = FALSE () )
    )
RETURN COUNTROWS ( DISTINCT ( SELECTCOLUMNS ( FILTER ( _t, [@u] > 1 ), "@k", DimResource[ResourceKey] ) ) ) + 0
measures.description: Active people above 100% utilisation in at least one month in view.

measures.name: Story | Months Over 100%
measures.description: Months in view in which utilisation is above 100%.

measures.name: Story | Free Capacity (h)
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    SUMMARIZE ( FactCapacity, DimResource[ResourceKey], DimDate[MonthStart] ),
    VAR _c = [Capacity | Resource Capacity]
    RETURN IF ( _c > 0, MAX ( 0, _c - COALESCE ( [Story | Scheduled Hours], 0 ) ) )
)
measures.description: Unscheduled capacity, summed per person and month (overload in one month does not cancel bench in another).

measures.name: Story | Committed Gap (h)
measures.expression:
VAR _s = [Story | Scheduled Hours]
VAR _k = [Story | Committed Hours]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _s ) && ISBLANK ( _k ), BLANK (), COALESCE ( _k, 0 ) - COALESCE ( _s, 0 ) )
measures.description: Committed minus scheduled hours on project plans, organisation-wide. Positive = more committed than scheduled.

measures.name: Story | Committed Without Schedule (h)
measures.expression:
VAR _t =
    CALCULATETABLE (
        SUMMARIZE ( FactResourcePlan, FactResourcePlan[ProjectKey], DimResource[ResourceKey], DimDate[MonthStart] ),
        REMOVEFILTERS ( DimProject ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] )
    )
RETURN
    SUMX ( _t,
        VAR _s = COALESCE ( [Story | Scheduled Hours], 0 )
        VAR _k = COALESCE ( [Story | Committed Hours], 0 )
        RETURN IF ( _s = 0 && _k > 0, _k ) )
measures.description: Committed hours in person × project × month cells that have no scheduled hours at all (project plans, organisation-wide).

measures.name: Story | Util Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _u = [Story | Utilisation %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _u ), BLANK (), IF ( _u > 1, "#C0392B", IF ( _u >= 0.8, "#1E6D6E", IF ( _u >= 0.5, "#D9A832", "#9AA3AF" ) ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Util Cell Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _u = [Story | Utilisation %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _u ), BLANK (), IF ( _u > 1, "#F8D0CC", IF ( _u >= 0.8, "#D3EEDB", IF ( _u >= 0.5, "#FBEFD0", "#EEF0F3" ) ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Resource Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _r = [Resource KPI | Total Resources]
VAR _c = [Capacity | Resource Capacity]
VAR _s = [Story | Scheduled Hours]
VAR _u = [Story | Utilisation %]
VAR _o = [Story | Over-allocated People]
VAR _role = 
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimResource[Role_Value] ), "@u", [Story | Utilisation %] ),
            NOT ISBLANK ( DimResource[Role_Value] ) && [@u] > 0 ),
        [@u], DESC, DimResource[Role_Value], ASC )
VAR _rn = TRIM ( MAXX ( _role, DimResource[Role_Value] ) )
VAR _ru = MAXX ( _role, [@u] )
VAR _k = [Story | Committed Hours]
VAR _gap = [Story | Committed Gap (h)]
VAR _absg = ABS ( COALESCE ( _gap, 0 ) )
VAR _nos = COALESCE ( [Story | Committed Without Schedule (h)], 0 )
RETURN
    IF ( COALESCE ( _c, 0 ) = 0,
        "No capacity in the current selection — pick a year or department with resource calendars.",
        FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _r, 0 ), "#,0" ) & " people offer " & FORMAT ( _c, "#,0" ) & " h of capacity; " & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _s, 0 ), "#,0" )
            & " h are scheduled on project plans  →  " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _u ), "–", FORMAT ( _u, "0%" ) ) & " utilised (organisation-wide). " & FORMAT ( _o, "0" )
            & " people go above 100% in at least one month"
            & IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _rn ), "; the most stretched role is " & _rn & " at " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _ru ), "–", FORMAT ( _ru, "0%" ) ), "" ) & ". "
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _k ), "No committed hours are recorded.",
                "Committed hours (" & FORMAT ( _k, "#,0" ) & " h) are "
                    & IF ( _absg = 0, "equal to scheduled",
                        FORMAT ( _absg, "#,0" ) & " h " & IF ( _gap > 0, "above", "below" ) & " scheduled" )
                    & IF ( _nos > 0, "; " & FORMAT ( _nos, "#,0" ) & " h are committed where nothing is scheduled", "" )
                    & " — reconcile the resource plans." )
    )

measures.name: Story | On Schedule %
measures.expression:
VAR _tot = CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[State_Value] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[ScheduleHealth_Value] ) ) )
VAR _ok = CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[State_Value] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[ScheduleHealth_Value] = "(1) On Track" ) )
RETURN IF ( _tot > 0, DIVIDE ( COALESCE ( _ok, 0 ), _tot ) )
measures.description: Share of active projects whose schedule health is (1) On Track.

measures.name: Story | Schedule At Risk
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[State_Value] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[ScheduleHealth_Value] = "(2) At Risk" ) ) + 0
measures.description: Active projects with schedule health (2) At Risk.

measures.name: Story | Schedule Off Track
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[State_Value] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimProject[ScheduleHealth_Value] = "(3) Off Track" ) ) + 0
measures.description: Active projects with schedule health (3) Off Track.

measures.name: Story | Overdue Tasks
measures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( DimTask, DimTask[WorkType] = "Tasks" && DimTask[Leaf] = TRUE () && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) && DimTask[PercentDone] < 100 && DimTask[Status] <> "Completed" && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[EndDate] ) && DimTask[EndDate] < TODAY () ) ) + 0
measures.description: Open leaf tasks on project plans (not Completed, under 100%) whose finish date has passed. Summary tasks are excluded. The one overdue definition used on every page.

measures.name: Story | Days Overdue
measures.expression: MAXX ( FILTER ( DimTask, DimTask[WorkType] = "Tasks" && DimTask[Leaf] = TRUE () && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) && DimTask[PercentDone] < 100 && DimTask[Status] <> "Completed" && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[EndDate] ) && DimTask[EndDate] < TODAY () ), INT ( TODAY () ) - INT ( DimTask[EndDate] ) )
measures.description: Days past the finish date for the tasks counted by Story | Overdue Tasks; blank for any other task (drives the late-task lists).

measures.name: Story | Milestones Next 30d
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    COUNTROWS ( DimTask ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[Milestone] = TRUE () ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[PercentDone] < 100 ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[EndDate] >= TODAY () && DimTask[EndDate] < TODAY () + 31 ),
    KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) )
) + 0

measures.name: Story | Project Slip (days)
measures.expression:
AVERAGEX (
    FILTER ( DimProject, NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Summary_EndDate] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Summary_BaselineEndDate] ) ),
    INT ( DimProject[Summary_EndDate] ) - INT ( DimProject[Summary_BaselineEndDate] )
)
measures.description: Average finish date minus baseline finish date, in days (projects with a baseline).

measures.name: Story | Task Slip (days)
measures.expression:
AVERAGEX (
    FILTER ( DimTask, DimTask[WorkType] = "Tasks" && DimTask[Leaf] = TRUE () && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] )
        && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[EndDate] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[BaselineEndDate] ) ),
    INT ( DimTask[EndDate] ) - INT ( DimTask[BaselineEndDate] )
)
measures.description: Average task finish minus baseline finish (leaf project tasks with a baseline).

measures.name: Story | Slipped Tasks
measures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( DimTask, DimTask[WorkType] = "Tasks" && DimTask[Leaf] = TRUE () && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) && DimTask[PercentDone] < 100 && DimTask[Status] <> "Completed" && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[EndDate] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[BaselineEndDate] ) && DimTask[EndDate] > DimTask[BaselineEndDate] ) ) + 0
measures.description: Open leaf project tasks whose current finish is later than their baseline finish (summary tasks excluded).

measures.name: Story | Late Task Slip (days)
measures.expression: AVERAGEX ( FILTER ( DimTask, DimTask[WorkType] = "Tasks" && DimTask[Leaf] = TRUE () && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) && DimTask[PercentDone] < 100 && DimTask[Status] <> "Completed" && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[EndDate] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[BaselineEndDate] ) && DimTask[EndDate] > DimTask[BaselineEndDate] ), INT ( DimTask[EndDate] ) - INT ( DimTask[BaselineEndDate] ) )
measures.description: Slip in days of the tasks counted by Story | Slipped Tasks; blank for any other task (drives the late-work register).

measures.name: Story | Due Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _d = MAX ( DimTask[EndDate] )
VAR _p = MAX ( DimTask[PercentDone] )
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _d ), BLANK (), IF ( _d < TODAY () && _p < 100, "#C0392B", IF ( _d < TODAY () + 14, "#D9A832", "#1F2A44" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Late Due Colour
measures.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Story | Late Task Slip (days)] ), BLANK (), [Story | Due Colour] )

measures.name: Story | Slip Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _d = [Story | Late Task Slip (days)]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _d ), BLANK (), IF ( _d > 20, "#C0392B", IF ( _d > 0, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Schedule Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _ot = [Story | On Schedule %]
VAR _ar = [Story | Schedule At Risk]
VAR _sl = [Story | Schedule Off Track]
VAR _od = [Story | Overdue Tasks]
VAR _ms = [Story | Milestones Next 30d]
VAR _slip = [Story | Project Slip (days)]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@n", CALCULATE ( MAX ( DimProject[Name] ) ),
            "@d", [Story | Project Slip (days)] ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) && [@d] > 0 ),
        [@d], DESC, DimProject[Id], ASC )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( _ot ), "–", FORMAT ( _ot, "0%" ) ) & " of active projects are on schedule; " & FORMAT ( _ar, "0" ) & " are at risk and " & FORMAT ( _sl, "0" )
        & " are off track. " & FORMAT ( _od, "#,0" ) & " project tasks are overdue and " & FORMAT ( _ms, "0" )
        & " milestone(s) fall due in the next 30 days. "
        & IF ( ISBLANK ( _slip ), "No baselines are set, so slippage cannot be measured yet.",
            "Projects now finish on average " & FORMAT ( ABS ( _slip ), "0" ) & " days " & IF ( _slip >= 0, "later", "earlier" )
                & " than baselined"
                & IF ( COUNTROWS ( _top ) > 0,
                    "; the biggest move is " & MAXX ( _top, [@n] ) & " (+" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _top, [@d] ), "0" ) & " days).",
                    "." ) )

measures.name: Story | Active Risk Count
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimTask ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[WorkType] = "Risks" ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[State] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) ) ) + 0
measures.description: Active risks on project plans.

measures.name: Story | Open Issues
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimTask ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[WorkType] = "Issues" ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[State] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) ) ) + 0
measures.description: Active issues on project plans.

measures.name: Story | Critical High Risks
measures.expression:
COUNTROWS (
    FILTER (
        CALCULATETABLE ( DimTask, KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[WorkType] = "Risks" ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[State] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) ) ),
        VAR _i = SWITCH ( LEFT ( DimTask[Impact], 3 ), "(1)", 4, "(2)", 3, "(3)", 2, "(4)", 1, 0 )
        VAR _p = SWITCH ( LEFT ( DimTask[Probability Category], 3 ), "(1)", 4, "(2)", 3, "(3)", 2, "(4)", 1, 0 )
        RETURN _i * _p >= 9
    )
) + 0
measures.description: Active project risks scoring 9 or more on the 4×4 impact × probability grid.

measures.name: Story | Risk Exposure
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( SUM ( DimTask[Exposure] ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[WorkType] = "Risks" ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[State] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) ) )
measures.description: Sum of the OnePlan Exposure score (probability % × impact weight) on active project risks. A score, not money.

measures.name: Story | Avg Risk Probability
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( AVERAGE ( DimTask[Probability] ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[WorkType] = "Risks" ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[State] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) ) ), 100 )

measures.name: Story | Unmitigated Risk %
measures.expression:
VAR _all = [Story | Active Risk Count]
VAR _un =
    COUNTROWS (
        FILTER ( CALCULATETABLE ( DimTask, KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[WorkType] = "Risks" ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimTask[State] = "Active" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[ProjectKey] ) ) ),
            LEN ( DimTask[Mitigation] ) = 0
                && LEN ( DimTask[MitigationActions] ) = 0
                && NOT ( DimTask[RiskStage] IN { "Mitigating", "Monitoring" } ) ) )
RETURN IF ( _all > 0, DIVIDE ( COALESCE ( _un, 0 ), _all ) )
measures.description: Share of active project risks with no mitigation text, no mitigation actions and not in the Mitigating/Monitoring stage.

measures.name: Story | Heat Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _i = SWITCH ( LEFT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( DimTask[Impact] ), 3 ), "(1)", 4, "(2)", 3, "(3)", 2, "(4)", 1, 0 )
VAR _p = SWITCH ( LEFT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( DimTask[Probability Category] ), 3 ), "(1)", 4, "(2)", 3, "(3)", 2, "(4)", 1, 0 )
VAR _sc = _i * _p
RETURN IF ( _sc = 0, BLANK (), IF ( _sc >= 12, "#E57368", IF ( _sc >= 9, "#F2B880", IF ( _sc >= 4, "#F7E3A1", "#D3EEDB" ) ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Risk Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _r = [Story | Active Risk Count]
VAR _ch = [Story | Critical High Risks]
VAR _e = [Story | Risk Exposure]
VAR _i = [Story | Open Issues]
VAR _u = [Story | Unmitigated Risk %]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Program Name] ), "@e", [Story | Risk Exposure] ),
            NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Program Name] ) && [@e] > 0 ),
        [@e], DESC, DimProject[Program Name], ASC )
RETURN
    FORMAT ( _r, "0" ) & " active project risks (" & FORMAT ( _ch, "0" ) & " critical or high on impact × probability) carry an exposure score of "
        & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _e, 0 ), "#,0" ) & ", and " & FORMAT ( _i, "0" ) & " issue(s) are open. "
        & IF ( COUNTROWS ( _top ) > 0,
            "Exposure is concentrated in " & MAXX ( _top, DimProject[Program Name] ) & " ("
                & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( MAXX ( _top, [@e] ), _e ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( MAXX ( _top, [@e] ), _e ), "0%" ) ) & "). ", "" )
        & IF ( _r > 0, IF ( ISBLANK ( _u ), "–", FORMAT ( _u, "0%" ) ) & " of active risks have no mitigation recorded yet.", "" )

measures.name: Story | Benefits Planned
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactCost[Cost] ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactCost[CostType] = "Benefits" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: Planned benefits of project plans from the financial plan (FactCost Benefits), phased by date; split by cost category Revenue / Cost Savings.

measures.name: Story | Benefits Actual
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactCost[Cost] ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactCost[CostType] = "Actual Benefits" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: Realised benefits of project plans recorded in OnePlan (FactCost cost type "Actual Benefits"). None are recorded yet on this tenant, so this stays blank.

measures.name: Story | Benefits Due To Date
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Story | Benefits Planned], KEEPFILTERS ( DimDate[Date] <= TODAY () ) )
measures.description: Planned benefits phased up to today.

measures.name: Story | Benefits At Completion
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Story | Benefits Planned], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ) )
measures.description: Planned benefits over the plan lifetime.

measures.name: Story | Benefits Realised %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Benefits Actual], [Story | Benefits Due To Date] )
measures.description: Actual benefits ÷ benefits due to date. Blank while no actuals are recorded.

measures.name: Story | Benefits Actual Label
measures.expression:
VAR _a = [Story | Benefits Actual]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _a ), "Not recorded", IF ( ISBLANK ( _a ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _a ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _a / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _a ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _a / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _a, "#,0" ) ) ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Benefits Realised KPI
measures.expression:
VAR _a = [Story | Benefits Actual]
VAR _d = [Story | Benefits Due To Date]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _a ), "Not recorded", IF ( COALESCE ( _d, 0 ) = 0, IF ( ISBLANK ( _a ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _a ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _a / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _a ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _a / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _a, "#,0" ) ) ) ), FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _a, _d ), "0%" ) & " of due" ) )
measures.description: Actual vs due-to-date benefits, or 'Not recorded' when OnePlan holds no actuals.

measures.name: Story | Benefit Cost Ratio
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Benefits At Completion], [Story | Finance EAC] )
measures.description: Planned benefits at completion divided by EAC.

measures.name: Story | Ratio Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _r = [Story | Benefit Cost Ratio]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _r ), BLANK (), IF ( _r >= 2, "#1E6D6E", IF ( _r >= 1, "#D9A832", "#C0392B" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Benefits Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _b = [Story | Benefits At Completion]
VAR _due = [Story | Benefits Due To Date]
VAR _a = [Story | Benefits Actual]
VAR _c = [Story | Finance EAC]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@n", CALCULATE ( MAX ( DimProject[Name] ) ),
            "@x", [Story | Benefit Cost Ratio] ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) && [@x] > 0 ),
        [@x], DESC, DimProject[Id], ASC )
VAR _neg = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ),
    NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) && [Story | Finance EAC] > 0 && COALESCE ( [Story | Benefits At Completion], 0 ) = 0 ) )
RETURN
    IF ( COALESCE ( _b, 0 ) = 0,
        "No planned benefits in the financial plans of this selection — capture expected benefits in OnePlan to tell the value story.",
        "The selection plans " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _b ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _b ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _b / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _b ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _b / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _b, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " of benefits against an EAC of " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _c ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _c ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _c / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _c ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _c / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _c, "#,0" ) ) ) )
            & IF ( COALESCE ( _c, 0 ) > 0, " (" & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _b, _c ), "0.0" ) & "× return)", "" ) & ". "
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _a ),
                "No actual benefits recorded yet in OnePlan — realisation cannot be measured; benefits due to date: " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _due ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _due ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _due / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _due ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _due / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _due, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & ".",
                "Actual benefits " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _a ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _a ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _a / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _a ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _a / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _a, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " against " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _due ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _due ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _due / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _due ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _due / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _due, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " due to date ("
                    & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _a, _due ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _a, _due ), "0%" ) ) & ")." )
            & IF ( COUNTROWS ( _top ) > 0,
                " Best value for money: " & MAXX ( _top, [@n] ) & " (" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _top, [@x] ), "0.0" ) & "×).", "" )
            & " " & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _neg, 0 ), "0" ) & " project(s) with an EAC have no planned benefit."
    )

measures.name: Story | Exec Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _n = [Story | Active Projects]
VAR _ot = [Story | On Track %]
VAR _vp = [Story | EAC Variance %]
VAR _u = [Story | Utilisation %]
VAR _o = [Story | Over-allocated People]
VAR _ch = [Story | Critical High Risks]
VAR _focus =
    SWITCH ( TRUE (),
        NOT ISBLANK ( _vp ) && _vp > 0.05, "cost overrun",
        _o > 0 && NOT ISBLANK ( _u ) && _u > 1, "resource overload",
        NOT ISBLANK ( _ot ) && _ot < 0.7, "delivery health",
        _ch > 5, "risk exposure",
        "keeping the course" )
RETURN
    FORMAT ( _n, "0" ) & " active projects, " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _ot ), "–", FORMAT ( _ot, "0%" ) ) & " on track. EAC is "
        & IF ( ISBLANK ( _vp ), "–", FORMAT ( _vp, "+0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%" ) ) & " versus budget at completion. Organisation-wide, people are " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _u ), "–", FORMAT ( _u, "0%" ) )
        & " utilised (" & FORMAT ( _o, "0" ) & " above 100% in at least one month) and " & FORMAT ( _ch, "0" )
        & " critical/high risks are open. This month's focus: " & _focus & "."

measures.name: Story | Exec Action Money
measures.expression:
VAR _n = [Story | Projects Over Budget]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER (
            ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@n", CALCULATE ( MAX ( DimProject[Name] ) ),
                "@b", [Story | Budget At Completion], "@v", [Story | EAC Variance] ),
            NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) && [@b] > 0 && [@v] > 0 ),
        [@v], DESC, DimProject[Id], ASC )
RETURN
    IF ( _n > 0,
        "1 · Money — review the " & FORMAT ( _n, "0" ) & " project(s) whose EAC is above budget — start with " & MAXX ( _top, [@n] )
            & " (+" & IF ( ISBLANK ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ) ), "–", IF ( ABS ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ) ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ) / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ) ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ) / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ), "#,0" ) ) ) ) & ").",
        "1 · Money — EAC is within budget on every project — protect the contingency and release unused budget." )

measures.name: Story | Exec Action People
measures.expression:
VAR _o = [Story | Over-allocated People]
VAR _role = 
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimResource[Role_Value] ), "@u", [Story | Utilisation %] ),
            NOT ISBLANK ( DimResource[Role_Value] ) && [@u] > 0 ),
        [@u], DESC, DimResource[Role_Value], ASC )
RETURN
    IF ( _o > 0,
        "2 · People — rebalance " & FORMAT ( _o, "0" ) & " people who go above 100% in at least one month; the most stretched role is "
            & TRIM ( MAXX ( _role, DimResource[Role_Value] ) ) & " (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( MAXX ( _role, [@u] ) ), "–", FORMAT ( MAXX ( _role, [@u] ), "0%" ) ) & ", organisation-wide).",
        "2 · People — nobody goes above 100% in any month — there is room to pull work forward from the pipeline." )

measures.name: Story | Exec Action Risk
measures.expression:
VAR _ch = [Story | Critical High Risks]
VAR _od = [Story | Overdue Tasks]
RETURN
    IF ( _ch > 0,
        "3 · Risk — escalate " & FORMAT ( _ch, "0" ) & " critical/high risk(s) to their owners and clear " & FORMAT ( _od, "#,0" ) & " overdue task(s).",
        "3 · Risk — no critical or high risk is open — " & FORMAT ( _od, "#,0" ) & " overdue task(s) remain to clear." )

measures.name: Story | Overrun
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    FILTER ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ),
    VAR _b = [Story | Budget At Completion]
    VAR _v = [Story | Finance EAC] - _b
    RETURN IF ( _b > 0 && _v > 0, _v )
)
measures.description: Sum of positive project overruns at completion (EAC above budget, projects with a budget); underruns do not net them off.

measures.name: Story | Spend Cum %
measures.expression:
VAR _cur = [Story | Finance EAC]
VAR _id = MAX ( DimProject[Id] )
VAR _t = FILTER ( CALCULATETABLE ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@c", [Story | Finance EAC] ), ALLSELECTED ( DimProject ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) )
VAR _all = SUMX ( _t, [@c] )
RETURN
    IF ( ISINSCOPE ( DimProject[Name] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( _id ) && _cur > 0,
        DIVIDE ( SUMX ( FILTER ( _t, [@c] > _cur || ( [@c] = _cur && DimProject[Id] <= _id ) ), [@c] ), _all ) )
measures.description: Pareto line: cumulative share of EAC across the selection, projects ranked from largest to smallest.

measures.name: Story | Overrun Cum %
measures.expression:
VAR _cur = [Story | Overrun]
VAR _id = MAX ( DimProject[Id] )
VAR _t = FILTER ( CALCULATETABLE ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@c", [Story | Overrun] ), ALLSELECTED ( DimProject ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) )
VAR _all = SUMX ( _t, [@c] )
RETURN
    IF ( ISINSCOPE ( DimProject[Name] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( _id ) && _cur > 0,
        DIVIDE ( SUMX ( FILTER ( _t, [@c] > _cur || ( [@c] = _cur && DimProject[Id] <= _id ) ), [@c] ), _all ) )

measures.name: Story | Spend Share
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Finance EAC], SUMX ( FILTER ( CALCULATETABLE ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@c", [Story | Finance EAC] ), ALLSELECTED ( DimProject ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ), [@c] ) )
measures.description: Share of the EAC of the whole selection.

measures.name: Story | Pareto Class
measures.expression:
VAR _cum = [Story | Spend Cum %]
VAR _prev = _cum - [Story | Spend Share]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _cum ), BLANK (), IF ( _prev < 0.8, "A · top 80%", IF ( _prev < 0.95, "B · next 15%", "C · tail 5%" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Pareto Class Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _c = LEFT ( [Story | Pareto Class], 1 )
RETURN SWITCH ( _c, "A", "#E8612A", "B", "#1F2A44", "C", "#9AA3AF", BLANK () )

measures.name: Story | Projects For 80% Spend
measures.expression:
VAR _t = FILTER ( FILTER ( CALCULATETABLE ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@c", [Story | Finance EAC] ), ALLSELECTED ( DimProject ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ), [@c] > 0 )
VAR _all = SUMX ( _t, [@c] )
VAR _r =
    ADDCOLUMNS ( _t, "@prev",
        VAR _x = [@c]
        VAR _id = DimProject[Id]
        RETURN SUMX ( FILTER ( _t, [@c] > _x || ( [@c] = _x && DimProject[Id] < _id ) ), [@c] ) )
RETURN COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( _r, COALESCE ( [@prev], 0 ) < 0.8 * _all ) ) + 0
measures.description: How many of the largest projects together make up 80% of EAC.

measures.name: Story | Projects With Spend
measures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( FILTER ( CALCULATETABLE ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@c", [Story | Finance EAC] ), ALLSELECTED ( DimProject ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ), [@c] > 0 ) ) + 0

measures.name: Story | Concentration %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Projects For 80% Spend], [Story | Projects With Spend] )
measures.description: Share of projects that make up 80% of EAC (lower = more concentrated).

measures.name: Story | Top3 Overrun Share
measures.expression:
VAR _t = FILTER ( CALCULATETABLE ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@o", [Story | Overrun] ), ALLSELECTED ( DimProject ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) )
RETURN DIVIDE ( SUMX ( TOPN ( 3, _t, [@o], DESC, DimProject[Id], ASC ), [@o] ), SUMX ( _t, [@o] ) )

measures.name: Story | Plan Revenue
measures.expression: SUM ( DimProject[EstimatedRevenue] )
measures.description: Estimated revenue field on the plan (lifetime). Not used by the P&L, which reads the financial plan.

measures.name: Story | Revenue At Completion
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactCost[Cost] ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactCost[CostType] = "Forecasted Revenue" ), REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ) )
measures.description: Forecasted revenue of project plans from the financial plan, lifetime. Blank while only non-project plans (e.g. engagements) carry forecasted revenue.

measures.name: Story | Total Value
measures.expression:
VAR _r = [Story | Revenue At Completion]
VAR _b = [Story | Benefits At Completion]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _r ) && ISBLANK ( _b ), BLANK (), COALESCE ( _r, 0 ) + COALESCE ( _b, 0 ) )
measures.description: Forecasted revenue plus planned benefits at completion (FactCost).

measures.name: Story | Net Value
measures.expression:
VAR _v = [Story | Total Value]
VAR _c = [Story | Finance EAC]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _v ) && ISBLANK ( _c ), BLANK (), COALESCE ( _v, 0 ) - COALESCE ( _c, 0 ) )
measures.description: Total value minus EAC, at completion (FactCost).

measures.name: Story | Net Margin %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Net Value], [Story | Total Value] )

measures.name: Story | Net ROI
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Net Value], [Story | Finance EAC] )
measures.description: Net value as a share of EAC.

measures.name: Story | Net Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _n = [Story | Net Value]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _n ), BLANK (), IF ( _n < 0, "#C0392B", IF ( [Story | Net Margin %] < 0.2, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Pareto PnL Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _k = [Story | Projects For 80% Spend]
VAR _m = [Story | Projects With Spend]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1, FILTER ( CALCULATETABLE ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@n", CALCULATE ( MAX ( DimProject[Name] ) ), "@c", [Story | Finance EAC] ), ALLSELECTED ( DimProject ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ),
        [@c], DESC, DimProject[Id], ASC )
VAR _tshare = DIVIDE ( MAXX ( _top, [@c] ), SUMX ( FILTER ( CALCULATETABLE ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), "@c", [Story | Finance EAC] ), ALLSELECTED ( DimProject ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ), [@c] ) )
VAR _o = [Story | Overrun]
VAR _o3 = [Story | Top3 Overrun Share]
VAR _v = [Story | Total Value]
VAR _c = [Story | Finance EAC]
VAR _n = [Story | Net Value]
VAR _p =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        FILTER ( VALUES ( DimProject[Portfolio Name] ),
            NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Portfolio Name] ) && DimProject[Portfolio Name] <> "(No portfolio)" ),
        "@n", [Story | Net Value] )
VAR _best = TOPN ( 1, FILTER ( _p, NOT ISBLANK ( [@n] ) ), [@n], DESC, DimProject[Portfolio Name], ASC )
VAR _worst = TOPN ( 1, FILTER ( _p, NOT ISBLANK ( [@n] ) ), [@n], ASC, DimProject[Portfolio Name], ASC )
RETURN
    IF ( _m = 0, "No EAC in the current selection.",
        FORMAT ( _k, "0" ) & " of " & FORMAT ( _m, "0" ) & " projects (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _k, _m ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _k, _m ), "0%" ) )
            & ") make up 80% of EAC; the largest, " & MAXX ( _top, [@n] ) & ", alone takes "
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _tshare ), "–", FORMAT ( _tshare, "0%" ) ) & ". "
            & IF ( COALESCE ( _o, 0 ) > 0,
                "Overruns at completion total " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _o ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _o ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _o / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _o ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _o / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _o, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " and the top 3 projects carry " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _o3 ), "–", FORMAT ( _o3, "0%" ) ) & " of it. ",
                "No project has an EAC above its budget. " )

VAR _ba = [Story | Scenario · Budget A]
VAR _bb = [Story | Scenario · Budget B]
VAR _ea = [Story | Scenario · Benefits A]
VAR _eb = [Story | Scenario · Benefits B]
VAR _db = _ba - _bb
VAR _de = _ea - _eb
VAR _ga = [Story | Scenario · Budget Gap A]
VAR _oa = [Story | Scenario · Plans Only A]
VAR _ob = [Story | Scenario · Plans Only B]
VAR _obb = [Story | Scenario · Budget Only B]
VAR _obe = [Story | Scenario · Benefits Only B]
VAR _rA = [Story | Scenario · Benefits per € A]
VAR _rB = [Story | Scenario · Benefits per € B]
RETURN
    IF ( COALESCE ( _n, 0 ) = 0,
        "No Portfolio Modeler scenarios found — create and commit scenarios in OnePlan Modeler to compare.",
    IF ( _n = 1 || _ka = _kb,
        "Pick two different scenarios in the Scenario A and Scenario B slicers to compare them.",
        "Funding A “" & _na & "” (" & [Story | Scenario · Commit Text A] & ") instead of B “" & _nb & "” ("
            & [Story | Scenario · Commit Text B] & "): budget " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _ba ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _ba ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _ba / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _ba ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _ba / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _ba, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " vs " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _bb ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _bb ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _bb / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _bb ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _bb / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _bb, "#,0" ) ) ) )
            & " (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( _db ), "–", IF ( _db >= 0, "+", "−" ) & IF ( ISBLANK ( ABS ( _db ) ), "–", IF ( ABS ( ABS ( _db ) ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( ABS ( _db ) / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( ABS ( _db ) ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( ABS ( _db ) / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( ABS ( _db ), "#,0" ) ) ) ) ) & "), benefits " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _ea ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _ea ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _ea / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _ea ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _ea / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _ea, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " vs " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _eb ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _eb ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _eb / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _eb ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _eb / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _eb, "#,0" ) ) ) )
            & " (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( _de ), "–", IF ( _de >= 0, "+", "−" ) & IF ( ISBLANK ( ABS ( _de ) ), "–", IF ( ABS ( ABS ( _de ) ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( ABS ( _de ) / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( ABS ( _de ) ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( ABS ( _de ) / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( ABS ( _de ), "#,0" ) ) ) ) ) & "); benefits per € " & FORMAT ( _rA, "0.00" ) & " vs " & FORMAT ( _rB, "0.00" ) & ". "
            & IF ( _ob > 0,
                "A does not fund " & FORMAT ( _ob, "0" ) & " plan" & IF ( _ob = 1, "", "s" ) & " that B funds ("
                    & IF ( ISBLANK ( _obb ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _obb ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _obb / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _obb ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _obb / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _obb, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " budget, " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _obe ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _obe ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _obe / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _obe ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _obe / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _obe, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " benefits)",
                "A funds every plan B funds" )
            & IF ( _oa > 0, " and adds " & FORMAT ( _oa, "0" ) & " of its own", "" ) & ". "
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _ga ), "A has no target budget.",
                "A is " & IF ( ISBLANK ( ABS ( _ga ) ), "–", IF ( ABS ( ABS ( _ga ) ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( ABS ( _ga ) / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( ABS ( _ga ) ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( ABS ( _ga ) / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( ABS ( _ga ), "#,0" ) ) ) ) & IF ( _ga > 0, " over", " under" ) & " its target budget." )
            & IF ( _picked, "", "  (Defaulted — pick scenarios in the A and B slicers.)" )
            & IF ( _lost, "  A picked name is not in the selected model, so that side fell back to the default.", "" )
            & IF ( _nm > 1, "  Scenario names can repeat across " & FORMAT ( _nm, "0" )
                & " Modeler models — pick one model to compare within it.", "" )
    ) )

VAR _a = [Timesheet | Actual Hours]

RETURN
    SWITCH (

        ISBLANK ( _s ) && ISBLANK ( _a ), "#9AA3AF",
        COALESCE ( _s, 0 ) = 0, "#8E1B12",
        _r > 1.2, "#C0392B",
        _r >= 0.8, "#1E6D6E",
        "#D9A832"
    )

measures.name: Story | Timesheet · Accuracy Band
measures.expression:
VAR _s = [Story | Timesheet · Scheduled To Date]
VAR _a = [Timesheet | Actual Hours]

RETURN

        TRUE (),
        ISBLANK ( _s ) && ISBLANK ( _a ), BLANK (),
        COALESCE ( _s, 0 ) = 0, "Unplanned work",
        ISBLANK ( _a ), "No time booked",
        _r > 1.2, "Over-run",
        _r >= 0.8, "On plan",

measures.expression:
VAR _s = [Story | Timesheet · Scheduled To Date]
VAR _a = [Timesheet | Actual Hours]

VAR _u = [Story | Timesheet · Unplanned Share %]
VAR _miss = COALESCE ( [Timesheet | Resources Missing Time], 0 )
VAR _wait = COALESCE ( [Story | Timesheet · Not Approved Hours], 0 )
VAR _lag = [Timesheet | Avg Approval Lag (days)]
RETURN

        FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _a, 0 ), "#,##0" ) & " approved hours booked against "
            & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _s, 0 ), "#,##0" ) & " scheduled to date"

            & IF ( _u > 0, FORMAT ( _u, "0%" ) & " of booked time went to projects with no schedule. ", "" )

                TRUE (),
                _miss > 0, _miss & " person(s) with committed work booked no time. Action: chase the missing timesheets.",
                _wait > 0, FORMAT ( _wait, "#,##0" ) & " h not yet approved. Action: chase the approvers.",

                "Time is in and approved."

measures.name: Story | TS Status · Status Code
measures.expression:
VAR _ws = SELECTEDVALUE ( DimDate[WeekStart] )
VAR _ps = _ws - 1
VAR _ref = [Story | TS Status · Reference Date]
RETURN
    IF (
        NOT ISBLANK ( _ws ) && HASONEVALUE ( DimResource[ResourceKey] )
            && _ps >= [Story | TS Status · Window Start] && _ps <= _ref,
        VAR _lines = CALCULATETABLE ( FactTimesheet, REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), FactTimesheet[PeriodStart] = _ps )
        VAR _n = COUNTROWS ( _lines )
        VAR _appr = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( _lines, FactTimesheet[IsApproved] = 1 && FactTimesheet[Hours] > 0 ) )
        VAR _wait = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( _lines,
            FactTimesheet[IsSubmitted] = 1 && FactTimesheet[IsApproved] = 0 && FactTimesheet[Hours] > 0 ) )
        VAR _draft = FILTER ( _lines, FactTimesheet[IsSubmitted] = 0 && FactTimesheet[Hours] > 0 )
        VAR _bounced = CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( FactTimesheetAudit[TimesheetBK] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ),
            FactTimesheetAudit[Action] IN { "Recall", "Unlock" } )
        VAR _ret = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( _draft, FactTimesheet[TimesheetBK] IN _bounced ) )
        VAR _due = _ps + 6 + 2 < _ref
        VAR _named = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( DimResource, DimResource[Generic] = FALSE () && DimResource[Inactive] = FALSE () ) ) > 0
        VAR _committed = CALCULATE ( [Capacity | Total Hours Committed], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ),
            DimDate[Date] >= EOMONTH ( _ps, -1 ) + 1, DimDate[Date] <= EOMONTH ( _ps + 6, 0 ) )
        RETURN
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                _ret > 0, 4,
                COUNTROWS ( _draft ) > 0, 3,
                _wait > 0, 2,
                _appr > 0, 1,
                _n > 0, 3,
                _due && _named && _committed > 0, 5
            )
    )
measures.description: Timesheet status of one resource in one week: 1 Approved, 2 Awaiting approval, 3 Draft, 4 Returned (recalled / unlocked and not resubmitted), 5 Missing (committed work, no timesheet, period overdue). Blank = nothing expected. Only meaningful for one resource and one week.

VAR _x = ADDCOLUMNS ( _t, "@first",

RETURN DIVIDE ( COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( _known, [@first] < FactTimesheet[PeriodEnd] + 3 ) ), COUNTROWS ( _known ) )

VAR _om = ( MAX ( _s, _ps ) + MIN ( _e, _pe ) ) / 2

        && _e >= CALCULATE ( MIN ( DimDate[Date] ), ALLSELECTED ( DimDate ) )

VAR _one = HASONEVALUE ( DimProject[Id] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( SELECTEDVALUE ( DimProject[Id] ) )

VAR _slip = [Story | Baseline · Finish Slip (days)]

VAR _cp = DIVIDE ( [Story | Baseline · Plan Cost (project)] - [Story | Baseline · Baseline Cost (project)], [Story | Baseline · Baseline Cost (project)] )
VAR _fp = [Story | Baseline · FTE Variance %]
VAR _age = IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Story | Baseline · Baseline Saved On] ), INT ( TODAY () ) - INT ( [Story | Baseline · Baseline Saved On] ) )
VAR _late = _slip > 0
VAR _early = _slip < 0
VAR _more = _hp > 0.05
VAR _same = NOT ISBLANK ( _hp ) && ABS ( _hp ) <= 0.05
VAR _main =
    SWITCH ( TRUE (),
        _late && _more, "▲ Scope growth: +" & FORMAT ( _slip, "0" ) & " d, " & FORMAT ( _hp, "+0%" ) & " hours",
        _late && _same, "▲ Stretched: +" & FORMAT ( _slip, "0" ) & " d for the same work"
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _fp ), "", " (FTE " & FORMAT ( _fp, "+0%;-0%" ) & ")" ),
        _late, "▲ Late: +" & FORMAT ( _slip, "0" ) & " d" & IF ( ISBLANK ( _hp ), "", ", " & FORMAT ( _hp, "+0%;-0%" ) & " hours" ),
        _early, "▼ Ahead: " & FORMAT ( _slip, "0" ) & " d" & IF ( _more, ", " & FORMAT ( _hp, "+0%" ) & " hours", "" ),
        _more, "▲ Compressed: " & FORMAT ( _hp, "+0%" ) & " hours, same finish"
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _fp ), "", " (FTE " & FORMAT ( _fp, "+0%;-0%" ) & ")" ),
        _cp > 0.05, "▲ Cost up " & FORMAT ( _cp, "+0%" ) & ", dates held",
        "● On baseline" )
RETURN
    IF ( _one,
        IF ( ISBLANK ( _bf ),
            IF ( ISFILTERED ( FactStatusReport[Summary_LastBaselineDate] ), "◇ No baseline on that date", "◇ No baseline" ),
            _main
                & IF ( NOT ( [Story | Baseline · Baseline Cost (project)] > 0 ), "  ·  no cost in baseline record", "" )
                & IF ( _age > 90 && _main <> "● On baseline", "  ·  baseline " & FORMAT ( _age, "0" ) & " d old", "" ) ) )

            "Schedule — " & FORMAT ( _late, "0" ) & " of " & FORMAT ( _b, "0" ) & IF ( _late = 1, " finishes", " finish" ) & " late; " & _wn & " slipped most (+"
                & FORMAT ( _ws, "0" ) & " days). "
                & IF ( ABS ( _ss ) < 1, "Starts held, so the delay comes from longer execution ("
                    & FORMAT ( _dd, "+0;-0" ) & " working days per late project) — look at progress, not at late starts.",
                    "Starts moved " & FORMAT ( _ss, "+0;-0" ) & " days on average — check what held up the kick-off." ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Baseline · Insight Cost
measures.expression:
VAR _b = [Story | Baseline · Baselined Projects]
VAR _cb = [Story | Baseline · Baseline Cost]
VAR _cv = [Story | Baseline · Cost Variance]
VAR _cp = [Story | Baseline · Cost Variance %]
VAR _nocost = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( FILTER ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Story | Baseline · Baseline Finish] ) && NOT ( [Story | Baseline · Baseline Cost (project)] > 0 ) ) ) + 0
RETURN
    IF ( _b = 0, "Cost — nothing to compare yet.",
        IF ( ISBLANK ( _cb ), "Cost — none of the baselines holds a cost, so cost drift is invisible. Assign rates before the next baseline.",
            "Cost — plan " & IF ( ISBLANK ( [Story | Baseline · Plan Cost vs Baseline] ), "–", IF ( ABS ( [Story | Baseline · Plan Cost vs Baseline] ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( [Story | Baseline · Plan Cost vs Baseline] / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( [Story | Baseline · Plan Cost vs Baseline] ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( [Story | Baseline · Plan Cost vs Baseline] / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( [Story | Baseline · Plan Cost vs Baseline], "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " against a baseline of " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _cb ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _cb ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _cb / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _cb ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _cb / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _cb, "#,0" ) ) ) )
                & " (" & FORMAT ( _cp, "+0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%" ) & ")"
                & IF ( _cp > 0.05, ": above the 5% tolerance, explain it before the next board.", IF ( _cv > 0, ": inside tolerance.", ": on or under budget." ) )
                & IF ( _nocost > 0, " " & FORMAT ( _nocost, "0" ) & " baselined project(s) hold no cost in the baseline.", "" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Baseline · Plan Cost vs Baseline
Story | Baseline · Insight Effort
measures.expression:
VAR _hb = [Story | Baseline · Baseline Hours]
VAR _hp = [Story | Baseline · Hours Variance %]
VAR _fb = [Story | Baseline · Baseline FTE]
VAR _fp = [Story | Baseline · Plan FTE]
VAR _fv = [Story | Baseline · FTE Variance %]
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( _hb ), "Hours & FTE — no baseline in view holds hours.",
        "Hours & FTE — hours " & FORMAT ( _hp, "+0%;-0%;0%" ) & "; "
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _fb ) || ISBLANK ( _fp ), "FTE cannot be compared (a duration is missing). ",
                "people needed at once (sum of project averages) " & FORMAT ( _fb, "0.0" ) & " → " & FORMAT ( _fp, "0.0" )
                    & " FTE (" & FORMAT ( _fv, "+0%;-0%;0%" ) & "). " )
            & SWITCH ( TRUE (),
                _hp > 0.05 && _fv > 0.1, "More work in the same window: the team must grow or dates will move.",
                _hp > 0.05, "More work, spread over a longer window: scope grew — is there a change request?",
                _fv < -0.1, "The same work is spread thinner: people are released, or the plan is waiting on them.",
                _fv > 0.1, "The same work is squeezed into less time: check the people can absorb it.",
                "Effort and intensity are in line with the baseline." ) )

measures.name: Story | Baseline · Insight Rebaseline
measures.expression:
VAR _r = [Story | Baseline · Rebaselined Projects]
VAR _t =
    TOPN ( 1, FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Id] ) ), "@v", [Story | Baseline · Versions] ), [@v] > 1 ), [@v], DESC, DimProject[Id], ASC )
VAR _tn = CALCULATE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( DimProject[Name] ), TREATAS ( SELECTCOLUMNS ( _t, "@id", DimProject[Id] ), DimProject[Id] ) )
VAR _tv = MAXX ( _t, [@v] )
RETURN
    IF ( _r = 0, "Re-baselining — no project in view has re-baselined: every deviation is measured against the original plan.",
        "Re-baselining — " & FORMAT ( _r, "0" ) & " project(s) saved more than one baseline (" & _tn & ": " & FORMAT ( _tv, "0" )
            & "). A new baseline resets the variance to zero — pick an earlier date in the Baseline slicer to see the drift since then." )
